explanation: Blocked: the input is incomplete, so no full-set regional totals can be produced. /workspace/data/records.csv contains 18 rows, not the 24 (R001-R024) the spec requires. No other copy of the source exists in /workspace or /shared, and /internal is out of scope, so the missing rows cannot be recovered from here. Unblocking requires a re-export of the complete 24-row source; once supplied, the totals are a direct recompute.
